title: Infinite One
lines: Scoring one of the biggest hits in bowling, The One shook the industry to the core. With the release of the Big One and the Infinite One, the success story continues.
There is a 1:9 chance of opening a special edition ball.
Any consumer who opens a special edition One will be eligible to receive a Real One for free.
The lucky finder must go to realone.ebonite.com to register the serial number on their special edition One ball to receive a Real One.
NOTE: Special Edition One Series Ball Give-A-Way is no longer active.
